title: TMASI Global Joins the International Travel & Health Insurance Conference (ITIC Global) 2026 as an Official Sponsor
summary: TMASI Global is proud to join the International Travel & Health Insurance Conference (ITIC Global) 2026 in Istanbul as an official sponsor, taking part in one of the leading international gatherings for travel insurance and medical assistance.
paragraphs: TMASI Global is proud to join the International Travel & Health Insurance Conference (ITIC Global) 2026 in Istanbul as an official sponsor, taking part in one of the leading international gatherings for the travel insurance, medical assistance, and global healthcare industries.

ITIC Global brings together insurers, assistance companies, medical providers, healthcare networks, and industry leaders from around the world, creating an important platform for building partnerships, exchanging expertise, and strengthening international cooperation.

For TMASI Global, participating in ITIC reflects our continued growth across international markets and our commitment to connecting global partners with reliable local medical networks and on-the-ground support.

Our work is built around helping international travelers access coordinated medical care wherever they are, from the first request for assistance through case management, insurance coordination, medical treatment, transportation, and follow-up.

As TMASI continues to strengthen its global presence, ITIC Global 2026 is another important opportunity to meet existing partners, build new relationships, and contribute to the development of the international assistance industry.
We look forward to meeting our partners and industry colleagues in Istanbul.

title: TMASI Global Announces Strategic Partnership with Hansa Medica Group at the Grand Egyptian Museum
summary: TMASI Global announces a strategic partnership with Hansa Medica Group, the trusted medical provider serving the Grand Egyptian Museum in Giza, Egypt.
paragraphs: TMASI Global is proud to announce a strategic partnership with Hansa Medica Group, the trusted medical provider serving the Grand Egyptian Museum in Giza, Egypt.

Located beside the Great Pyramids of Giza, the Grand Egyptian Museum is one of the world's most significant cultural destinations and the largest archaeological museum dedicated to a single civilization. Welcoming visitors from around the globe, it represents a new international benchmark for tourism, culture, and visitor experience.

Through this partnership, Hansa Medica Group provides on-site medical care, while TMASI Global supports international travelers with medical assistance, case coordination, insurance communication, and patient support.

Together, the two companies create a seamless bridge between local medical care and the international assistance ecosystem. For travelers, this means coordinated support throughout the medical journey, from the first request for assistance to treatment, documentation, insurance coordination, and further arrangements when required.

For TMASI Global, this partnership is about more than expanding its medical network. It reflects a shared commitment to quality, reliability, and the standards expected at one of the world's most iconic destinations.

As millions of international visitors discover the Grand Egyptian Museum, TMASI Global is honored to work alongside Hansa Medica Group in helping ensure access to trusted, coordinated medical support.
TMASI Global: where global medical assistance meets local execution.

title: TMASI GLOBAL Signs Strategic Cooperation Agreement with Egypt Healthcare Authority at Africa Health ExCon 2025
summary: TMASI GLOBAL announces the signing of a strategic cooperation agreement with the Egypt Healthcare Authority (EHA) during Africa Health ExCon 2025 in Cairo.
paragraphs: TMASI GLOBAL is proud to announce the signing of a strategic cooperation agreement with the Egypt Healthcare Authority (EHA) during the prestigious Africa Health ExCon 2025 in Cairo.

The agreement was formally signed by Mr. Ameer ElTelwany, CEO of the Egypt Healthcare Authority, and Dr. Amr Abbass, Founder and CEO of TMASI GLOBAL. This milestone partnership underscores our shared commitment to advancing Egypt's position as a premier destination for medical tourism.

Through this cooperation, TMASI GLOBAL and the EHA will work together to enhance the international patient journey, integrate resources across the healthcare system, optimize operational efficiency, and deliver world-class care under the unified brand: 'We Care For You in Egypt.'

As part of Africa Health ExCon 2025, Dr. Ahmed ElSobky, Chairman of the Egypt Healthcare Authority, also announced the signing of multiple key agreements with leading national and international organizations. These partnerships support the Authority's strategic vision to strengthen Egypt's integrated healthcare system, expand medical tourism, and boost regional competitiveness in healthcare delivery and education.
We at TMASI GLOBAL are honored to contribute to this national effort and deeply appreciate the trust and collaboration extended to us by the Egypt Healthcare Authority.
Together, we look forward to creating meaningful change for patients, providers, and partners, and to reinforcing Egypt's reputation as a center of excellence in global healthcare.

title: TMASI GLOBAL at the Heart of Global Insurance Innovation
summary: TMASI Global participates in the 17th Annual Global Insurance Conference by Uniglobal, shaping the future of healthcare, travel, and insurance solutions.
paragraphs: TMASI Global is proud to participate in the 17th Annual Global Insurance Conference by Uniglobal, a premier gathering of leaders and innovators shaping the future of healthcare, travel, and insurance solutions.

This prestigious event unites top executives, insurers, healthcare providers, and assistance companies from across the world. For TMASI, it is a powerful platform to strengthen collaborations, share expertise, and showcase our mission of delivering trusted medical, travel, and tourism assistance worldwide.

At TMASI Global, we believe that healthcare and travel should be seamlessly connected, ensuring safety, accessibility, and peace of mind for individuals and partners alike. By attending this global forum, we reaffirm our commitment to bridging international insurers, providers, and patients through an integrated network of support that operates 24/7.

Our presence at the Barcelona conference highlights TMASI's role as a strategic partner for health, insurance, and medical tourism solutions. What truly sets us apart is our unique ability to bring medical and travel assistance directly inside hotels and resorts, ensuring travelers have immediate access to care where they stay.

This model not only elevates guest safety and wellbeing but also provides our partners with a premium service that strengthens trust and satisfaction. Through innovation and trusted partnerships, we are working to expand access to emergency medical assistance, international healthcare pathways, and travel support services that meet the highest global standards.

At TMASI Global, our vision goes beyond assistance: we aim to redefine the standard of safety and care for travelers worldwide. By combining international reach with local expertise, we are building a future where healthcare, insurance, and travel work hand in hand to create a world of seamless, reliable support.
The future of global healthcare and travel protection is here, and TMASI Global is proud to be at its heart.

title: TMASI Global Exhibited at ITIC Global Venice 2025: Strengthening Global Medical Assistance Partnerships
summary: TMASI Global proudly participated as an Exhibitor at the International Travel & Health Insurance Conference (ITIC Global 2025) in Venice, Italy.
paragraphs: TMASI Global proudly participated as an Exhibitor at the International Travel & Health Insurance Conference (ITIC Global 2025), held this November in the remarkable city of Venice, Italy.

The event gathered global leaders from the travel insurance, healthcare, and medical assistance industries, providing an exceptional platform for building partnerships, sharing expertise, and exploring the future of international collaboration in travel and health support.

Representing TMASI Global at the conference were Dr. Mohamed Roshdy, Deputy CEO; Elena Rethorn, International Business Affairs Consultant; and Irina Tretyakova, Strategic Growth and Partnerships Manager.

Throughout the conference, the TMASI Global team engaged with insurers, assistance companies, TPAs, and healthcare stakeholders from around the world, presenting the company's integrated capabilities in emergency medical response and international patient coordination.

The participation demonstrated TMASI Global's commitment to providing fast, reliable, and coordinated medical support to travelers worldwide. The company's model combines medical expertise, operational excellence, and an extensive provider network, ensuring seamless service from the first emergency call to complete case management.

TMASI Global's participation at ITIC Global Venice 2025 strengthened its position as a trusted global partner for insurers and assistance networks, marking another important milestone in the company's mission to expand international partnerships and advance the future of integrated medical and travel assistance solutions.

title: TMASI Global Takes the Stage at ITIC Global Venice 2025
summary: Elena Rethorn, International Business Affairs Consultant, represents TMASI Global as a panel speaker at ITIC Global Venice 2025.
paragraphs: This year, TMASI Global had the honor of taking the stage at the ITIC Global 2025 International Travel & Health Insurance Conference in Venice, one of the most prestigious global events for the travel and health insurance industry.
Our representative, Elena Rethorn, International Business Affairs Consultant, was invited as a speaker to join an expert panel discussion exploring future directions in travel assistance.

Her contribution highlighted TMASI Global's strategic understanding of international healthcare dynamics and its role as a thought leader shaping the future of medical assistance and travel risk management.

By actively participating in high-level industry discussions, TMASI Global continues to reinforce its position as a trusted global partner committed to innovation, collaboration, and excellence in delivering integrated medical and travel assistance solutions.

The company's presence at ITIC Global Venice 2025 marked another milestone in its mission to connect insurers, assistance networks, and medical providers worldwide, strengthening the foundation for a safer and more resilient global travel ecosystem.
